name: sentientcore
description: Research demo by Sentinel Sage: tune nine ethical factors on a crisis scenario → Deliberative Ensemble decision + ASpI review. LightGBM + GNN + SNN (numpy serving). Not ethical advice.

paragraphs: Pick a crisis, adjust what matters (or keep suggested defaults) → see a plain-language recommendation, with optional branch / ASpI details.

Responsible use: SentientCore is a research demo. It is not ethical advice, triage guidance, or a production decision system. Do not use ensemble outputs to make real-world policy or safety decisions.

There is no third-party labelled ethics dataset distributed or cited as the training corpus. The Deliberative Ensemble weights are project artifacts; they cannot currently be reproduced from source in this repository. Do not treat outputs as evaluated against a public benchmark.
features: React UI: crisis picker, factor presets + short “what matters” path (full nine under Fine-tune), “See recommendation” CTA, result-first panel (factors collapse after success), collapsible reflection/chart/tech details,…
Django REST API: POST /api/predict/, GET /api/scenarios/, GET /api/health/.
Demo defaults: admin off, JSON-only API responses, per-IP throttling, optional server-side X-Demo-Key.
Env-driven settings (secret, debug, hosts, CORS, inference backend).

whatItDoes.text: Pick a crisis, adjust what matters (or keep suggested defaults) → see a plain-language recommendation, with optional branch / ASpI details.

requirements.text: The live demo is a free-tier Render deployment: API + static UI via render.yaml, with demo-oriented defaults (SENTIENTCOREDEMOMODE — admin off, throttling, optional server-side API key).
The UI may load Philosopher from Google Fonts; a future hardening step is to self-host fonts to avoid third-party requests from the demo page.
Demo mode: safer admin defaults, throttling, optional API key, scenarios from JSON.
